text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh~~!! I can't believe she got so 
badly huuurt~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Lady Shiraoki has abandoned meee~~!!
choice_data_list: I think that's a bit much...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! Getting hurt this 
badly... is absolute proof that the divine 
protection is gone, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Without Lady Shiraoki, I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's like a fried egg without the egg!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Yes, you're right... I need to 
go pray to Shiraoki-sama.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I'll still keep trying, I want to try my 
best... So please, don't give up on 
someone as useless as me, she said."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still... if you were to never even look my 
way again... then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
M-My precious 5,000 yen... in the offering 
box...

Afterward, I went with her to a nearby 
shrine, but... perhaps weighed down by 
dejection, neither her physical condition 
nor her motivation would easily recover.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eep! T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're amazing, Trainer, being able 
to sound so confident.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Compared to a wimpy, gloomy nobody like 
me, they're like the moon and a softshell 
turtle. ...No, the moon and a stinkbug.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm a stink buuuug~~~!

Because she was so disheartened, the 
injury healed poorly... and it ended up 
taking quite a while to fully recover.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I really have nothing left. 
There's nothing more for me..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh~~! Thank you so much~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I... I'll do my best~~!

And so, the two joined forces to make sure 
she rested well, all fired up to resume 
training!
